resources.string: "A lighter touch for your phone. Let\'s enable two essential permissions before you begin."
"Replace worn-out hardware with floating controls and home-screen widgets. No root. No account. No ads."
"Keeps your floating button within reach while you use other apps."
"Allows your taps to lock the screen, open the power menu, and use Home, Back and Recents."
"\n\nAndroid will ask you to enable PowerBull controls. Only continue if you agree. On some Android versions, sideloaded apps require Allow restricted settings from the app\'s system info page."
"Enable both permissions in Android settings to continue"
"You stay in control. Permissions can be revoked in Android settings at any time. PowerBull does not read your screen or collect your data."
"Your everyday buttons, one effortless touch away."
"Tap to expand · Drag to move · Snaps to the edge"
"Lock screen turns the display off. Power menu opens Android\'s system controls. A software button cannot turn on a powered-off phone or wake a sleeping screen."
"A compact, icon-only panel with just what you need."
"Preview · Settings and close are always available"
"Dim the bubble after a few quiet seconds."
"Choose any combination. At least one action stays enabled. Turn an action off and on to move it to the end."
"Independent buttons, right on your home screen."
"Add a PowerBull widget, then choose its action. Add it again for another button. Resize it using your launcher\'s widget handles."
"If your launcher doesn\'t support adding widgets from an app: long-press your home screen → Widgets → PowerBull button. Widgets need the accessibility service enabled for system actions."
"Add PowerBull from your launcher\'s Widgets menu"

"No ads, analytics, accounts or internet permission. Settings stay on your device. Accessibility is used only for the control you choose; PowerBull does not read your screen, type text, or record your activity."

"• Android 9 or newer is required.
• Lock and navigation rely on Accessibility.
• Power menu availability depends on your phone.
• Media volume may be limited by Android or an audio device.
• Secure screens may hide overlays.
• If the bubble disappears, check Accessibility and your manufacturer's background/battery restrictions.
• After restarting, Android may need you to unlock once before the service starts.
• PowerBull cannot turn on a powered-off device."
"If PowerBull makes your day easier, you can buy its creator a coffee. Always optional. No pop-ups, no reminders."
"Navy. Red. A little energy.\nOriginal PowerBull identity — not affiliated with Red Bull or Apple."
"PowerBull floating controls. Tap to open, drag to move, long press for settings."
"This action is unavailable on this device right now"
